spans.s: Agreeable, sweet, charming, pleasant; विविक्तवर्णाभरणा सुखश्रुतिः
Taking delight in, favourable to; Ś.7.18.
(In phil.) The effort to win future beatitude.
खम् Happiness, joy, delight, pleasure, comfort; यदेवोपनतं दुःखात् सुखं तद्रसवत्तरम्
Well-being, welfare, health; देवीं सुखं प्रष्टुं गता
Ease, comfort, alleviation (of sorrow &c.); oft in comp; as in सुखशयित, सुखोपविष्ट, सुखाश्रय &c.
Happily, joyfully; भ्रातृभिः सहितो रामः प्रमुमोद सुखं सुखी
Well; सुखमास्तां भवान् 'many you fare well'.
At ease, comfortably; असंजातकिणस्कन्धः सुखं स्वपिति गौर्गडिः K.
Easily, with ease; अज्ञः सुखमाराध्यः सुखतरमाराध्यते विशेषज्ञः
Quietly, placidly; सुखं रात्रीः शयिता वीतमन्युः Kaṭh.1.11. -Comp. -अन्त a.
destroying happiness. -अधिष्ठानम् a happy state. -अभियोज्य a. easily assailable. -अभ्युदयिक a. causing joy or pleasure; सुखाभ्युदयिकं चैव नैःश्रेयसिकमेव च
. -आगतम् welcome. -आजातः N. of Śiva.-आत्मक a. consisting of pleasure. -आत्मन् the Supreme Spirit, Brahma; पृथगाचरतस्तात पृथगात्मसुखात्मनोः

. -आधारः paradise. -आप a. easily won or attained. -आप्लव a. suitable for bathing. -आयतः, -आयनः a good or well-trained horse. -आराध्य a. easy to be conciliated or propitiated. -आरोह a. of easy ascent. -आलोक a. good-looking, lovely, charming-आवह a. conducing to happiness, pleasant, comfortable.
N. of Varuṇa. -आशकः a cucumber. -आसक्तः an epithet of Śiva. -आसनम् a comfortable seat. -आसीन a. comfortably seated; also सुखनिविष्ट. -आस्वाद a.
enjoyment (of pleasure). -उचित a. accustomed to comfort or happiness.
उदयः dawn or realization of happiness.

an intoxicating drink. -उदर्क a. resulting in happiness.-उद्भवा yellow myrobalan; L. D. B. -उद्य a. to be spoken easily or agreeably. -उपविष्ट a. comfortably seated, sitting at ease. -एषिन् a. desiring happiness, wishing well to. -ऊर्जिकः natron. -कर, -कार, -दायकa. giving pleasure, pleasant. -चारः a good horse.-जात a. happy; सुखजातः सुरापीतः ......
. -तन्त्रa. enjoying pleasure; अर्थधर्मौ च संगृह्य सुखतन्त्रो न चालसः
. -द a. giving pleasure. (-दः) N. of Viṣṇu.
the Śamī tree. (-दम्) the seat of Viṣṇu. -दोह्या a cow easily milked. -प्रविचार a. easily accessible. -प्रश्नः inquiry as to welfare. -बद्ध a. lovely.
easy knowledge. -भागिन्, -भाज् a. happy. -भेद्य a. easy to be broken (fig. also), fragile, brittle. -मानिन् seeking joy in. -मोदा the gum olibanum tree.
रात्रिः the night of new moon (when lamps are lighted in honour of Lakṣmī).
a night when the husband may legally cohabit with his wife; see

. -रात्रिः, -रात्रिका Lakṣmī. -रूप a. having an agreeable appearance.-वर्चकः, -वर्चस् m. natron, alkali. -वह a. easily borne or carried. -वासः a water-melon. -वेदनम् consciousness of pleasure. -श्रव, -श्रुति a. sweet to the ear, melodious; विविक्तवर्णाभरणा सुखश्रुतिः प्रसादयन्ती हृदयान्यपि द्विषाम्
. -संगिन a. attached to pleasure; बद्धमिव स्वैरगतिर्जनमिह सुखसंगिनमवैमि Ś.5.11. -संदु(दो)ह्या f. a cow easily milked; L. D. B. -संयोगः gain of eternal bliss; धर्मार्थप्रभवं चैव सुखसंयोगमक्षयम्
. -साध्य a. easy to be accomplished or cured &c. -सुखेन ind. most willingly. -सेव्य a. easy of access. -स्वर्श a.
gratifying, pleasant; सेव्य- मानौ सुखस्पर्शैः शालनिर्यासगन्धिभिः
. -हस्त a. having a soft or gentle hand.
सुखंकर [sukhaṅkara], a. = सुखकर q. v. above.
सुखंघुणः [sukhaṅghuṇḥ] सुखंसुणः [sukhaṃsuṇḥ], सुखंसुणः A kind of staff with a skull at the top (a weapon of Śiva); see खट्वाङ्ग.
सुखयति [sukhayati], Den. P. Top give pleasure to, please, delight; पौरस्त्यो वा सुखयति मरुत्साधुसंवाहनाभिः
सुखाकृ [sukhākṛ], 8. U. To make happy, please.
सुखाकृत [sukhākṛta], a. Pleasant, comfortable; इयं कुसुमसंघातै- रुपस्तीर्णा सुखाकृता (भूमिः)
सुखित [sukhita], a. Pleased, delighted, happy. -तम् Happiness.
सुखिन् [sukhin], a. Happy, glad, joyful. -m. A religious ascetic.
सुख् [sukh], 1 P. (सुखयति) To make happy, please, delight; (properly a denom. of सुख).
